name: Martinus Partner Link Formatter
description: Add a partner ID to Martinus eshop links.
project_description:
This module provides new formatter for the link field type. This formatter formats link so it contains Martinus affiliate (partner) program. In order to use this module you have to be registered with Martinus partner program here: https://partner.martinus.sk 

 Features 
 Basic functionality is described above.

 Post-Installation 
 Install the module, then select the formatter for the links you want to use as Martinus partner links. Do not forget to specify partner ID in formatter settings.

 Additional Requirements 
 No additional requirements.
